introHtml: Orange pretzels bring a bold pop of color to any snack lineup, making them ideal for fall events, Halloween giveaways, or branded food items that stand out. The vibrant coating pairs well with classic salted or yogurt-covered pretzels, and your logo can be imprinted directly on the packaging for maximum visibility. Perfect for trade shows, corporate gifts, or break room treats.
